visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black cap, glasses, and a denim jacket holds a phone for a selfie, smiling broadly next to a young woman with long dark hair wearing a tight red top and denim skirt. They are standing on an urban sidewalk with high-rise buildings and city traffic behind them. A pink text box appears at the top. (2) The scene transitions to a wide shot of a modern glass building exterior with multiple large digital display windows labeled 'ETERNAL AESTHETIC CLINIC'. A pedestrian in a pink shirt walks past the screens, which show high-contrast footage of the same man in a purple suit dancing. (3) The man in the denim jacket enters the frame from the left, walking past the electronic displays where his own image is visible. He stops and points enthusiastically at the screen while the camera pans slightly. (4) The woman in the red top takes over the center frame in front of the clinic's digital screens. She performs a series of energetic dance moves and cute poses, including heart gestures and arm extensions, while the billboard behind her displays her and the man in various stylish outfits.
